title: Ariadne.NET rule pack, schema 2
description: A rule pack for Ariadne.NET. The loader is the authority: this schema checks shape only, not cross-references such as layer names or duplicate ids.

version.description: The pack author's own version, default "1.0.0". Unrelated to schema.

extends.description: Parent pack references: builtin://name or import://name.

rules.description: List of forbid, allowOnly, require, bannedPackages and uniqueNames rules.

componentRoles.description: List of component roles, used for code generation and role checks.

layer.description: A layer says which types it covers and which other layers those types may depend on. In a child pack an entry with only name, namespaces and assemblies retargets an inherited layer.

name.description: Unique in the merged pack. Referenced by allowedDependencies, rule targets and roles.

id.description: The rule id that layer-dependency violations carry. Unique across all layer and rule ids in the merged pack.

because.description: Why the layer may depend only on what it lists. Repeated on every violation.

assemblies.description: Assembly name globs the layer covers.

allowedDependencies.description: Names of the layers this layer may depend on. Default empty.

allowEmpty.description: Accept a role that matches no type.

namingConventions.description: Templates for namespaces and file paths.
